Method of Attack: Double-extortion ransomware operation that steals data before encrypting devices
Terminates processes matching a hardcoded list to free files for encryption
Drops ransom notes demanding contact via Tox chat within three days or threatens public data exposure
Excludes certain file types and folders from encryption
Uses Windows cryptographic API and CryptGenRandom function for encryption key generation
Appends .lilith file extension to encrypted files
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note with Tox chat address
Exclusion of 'ecdh_pub_k.bin' file (related to BABUK ransomware key)
Hardcoded process termination list including Outlook, SQL, Thunderbird, Steam, PowerPoint, WordPad, Firefox
